---
title: "05_analysis_1: Patient, control and lesion expression"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Intention

input file: 03_dat_aug.tsv\
output files: results/05_rel_expr_all_genes_hist.png, results/05_rel_expr_bar.png, results/05_top10_endo_grid.png, results/05_top10_peri_grid.png, results/05_lesion_all_genes_hist.png, results/05_lesion_bar.png, results/05_top10_peritoneal_lesion_grid.png, results/05_top10_ovarian_lesion_grid.png, results/05_top10_deep_lesion_grid.png

## Loading the libraries and data

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

Load the augmented data, arrange groups and make the data long (one row per sample per gene)

```{r}
#read data and fix the order of the groups so plots don't sort them alphabetically
data_aug <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv")) |>
  mutate(Plot_group = factor(Plot_group,
                             levels = c("Control endometrium", "Patient endometrium",
                                        "Control peritoneum", "Patient peritoneum",
                                        "Peritoneal lesion", "Ovarian endometrioma",
                                        "Deep infiltrating")))

#long format: one row per sample per gene
data_long <- data_aug |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Sample, Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Lesion_subtype, Plot_group),
               names_to = "Gene",
               values_to = "Expression")

#make results folder
dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
data_long
```

## Plot 1: Patient vs. control in endometrium and peritoneum

### Calculations

Calculating relative expression for endometrium and peritoneum samples, and finding the top 10 most changed genes in each tissue.

Relative expression = expression minus the control mean of the same tissue (CE for endometrium, CP for peritoneum).

```{r}
#subtract the CE mean from endometrium samples and the CP mean from peritoneum samples
rel_expr <- data_long |>
  filter(Tissue != "Lesion") |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  mutate(Rel_expr = case_when(
    Tissue == "Endometrium" ~ Expression - mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CE"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Tissue == "Peritoneum"  ~ Expression - mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CP"], na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  ungroup()

#mean change per gene in patients, for every gene
rel_expr_means <- rel_expr |>
  filter(Group == "Patient") |>
  group_by(Tissue, Gene) |>
  summarise(Mean_rel_expr = mean(Rel_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

#the 10 biggest changes (up or down) per tissue
rel_expr_top10 <- rel_expr_means |>
  group_by(Tissue) |>
  slice_max(abs(Mean_rel_expr), n = 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, Mean_rel_expr))

#defining the top 10 genes, used for the plots
top10_endo_genes <- rel_expr_top10 |> filter(Tissue == "Endometrium") |> pull(Gene) |> as.character()
top10_peri_genes <- rel_expr_top10 |> filter(Tissue == "Peritoneum") |> pull(Gene) |> as.character()

#relative expression vs. CE and vs. CP for all samples, used in the boxplots
rel_expr_ce <- data_long |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  mutate(Rel_expr = Expression - mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CE"], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

rel_expr_cp <- data_long |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  mutate(Rel_expr = Expression - mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CP"], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

top10_endo_genes
top10_peri_genes
```

### Histogram of the mean relative expression for all genes

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#plotting histogram of all genes
rel_expr_all_hist <- rel_expr_means |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Mean_rel_expr,
             fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100,
                 alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Tissue) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of relative expression across all genes",
       subtitle = "Mean relative expression per gene in patients (PE vs. CE, PP vs. CP)",
       x = "Mean relative expression",
       y = "Number of genes") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

rel_expr_all_hist

ggsave(here("results/05_rel_expr_all_genes_hist.png"),
       plot = rel_expr_all_hist,
       width = 12,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)
```

### Bar plot of the top 10 genes per tissue, showing how much they go up or down in patients

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
rel_expr_bar <- rel_expr_top10 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Gene,
             y = Mean_rel_expr,
             fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  #two panels in the plot, one panel per tissue, showing the top 10 genes
  facet_wrap(~ Tissue,
             scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Relative expression: patient vs. control",
       subtitle = "Top 10 genes with biggest expression difference per tissue (PE vs. CE, PP vs. CP)",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Mean relative expression") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

rel_expr_bar

ggsave(here("results/05_rel_expr_bar.png"),
       plot = rel_expr_bar,
       width = 12,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)

```

### Boxplots of the top 10 endometrium genes across all groups, relative to CE

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
#plot showing relative expression to CE for all samples, including peritoneum and lesions
endo_plot <- rel_expr_ce |>
  filter(Gene %in% top10_endo_genes) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Plot_group,
             y = Rel_expr,
             fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,
               alpha = 0.7) +
  #one panel per gene
  facet_wrap(~ Gene,
             ncol = 5,
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Top 10 changed genes in endometrium across all groups",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Relative expression") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

endo_plot

ggsave(here("results/05_top10_endo_grid.png"),
       plot = endo_plot,
       width = 14,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 300)
```

## Plot 2: Lesions vs. control endometrium

### Calculations

Using the relative expression vs. CE from Plot 1 to find the top 10 most changed genes for each lesion type.

```{r}
#mean change per gene vs. CE in each lesion type, for every gene
lesion_means <- rel_expr_ce |>
  filter(Tissue == "Lesion") |>
  group_by(Lesion_type, Gene) |>
  summarise(Mean_rel_expr = mean(Rel_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

#the 10 biggest changes per lesion type
lesion_top10 <- lesion_means |>
  group_by(Lesion_type) |>
  slice_max(abs(Mean_rel_expr), n = 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, Mean_rel_expr))

#defining the top 10 genes for each lesion type, used for the plots
top10_peritoneal_genes <- lesion_top10 |> filter(Lesion_type == "Peritoneal lesion") |> pull(Gene) |> as.character()
top10_ovarian_genes    <- lesion_top10 |> filter(Lesion_type == "Ovarian endometrioma") |> pull(Gene) |> as.character()
top10_deep_genes       <- lesion_top10 |> filter(Lesion_type == "Deep infiltrating") |> pull(Gene) |> as.character()

top10_peritoneal_genes
top10_ovarian_genes
top10_deep_genes
```

### Histogram of the mean relative expression for all genes in each lesion type

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5
#plotting histogram of all genes, per lesion
lesion_all_hist <- lesion_means |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Mean_rel_expr,
             fill = Lesion_type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100,
                 alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Lesion_type) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of relative expression across all genes",
       subtitle = "Mean expression per gene in each lesion type minus control endometrium (CE)",
       x = "Mean relative expression",
       y = "Number of genes") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

lesion_all_hist

ggsave(here("results/05_lesion_all_genes_hist.png"),
       plot = lesion_all_hist,
       width = 14,
       height = 5,
       dpi = 300)
```
